title: 菊花賞の後に・新時代の予感

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is over… Mejiro Ryan's impassioned shouts of victory echo throughout the course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite having lost, Mejiro McQueen compliments Ryan on her win, declaring this the beginning of a golden age for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this great achievement, the Kikuka Sho draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race is the Arima Kinen. Mejiro Ryan must now prepare for a race where many new, strong opponents await.
